review: Private whole-API wrapper and output-encoding source review v1

checks.result: Private exact core namespace, shape namespace and global Timer are renamed before core include and immediately undefined afterward; wrapper implementation remains in its own namespace.
Candidate uses distinct core/shape/Timer names and the same wrapper implementation include; no raw private Match crosses wrapper boundary.
Each wrapper owns a unique implementation shell; copying is forbidden. Move construction is allowed to allocate wrapper shell; only core moves are required noexcept.
Actual core MatchWorkspace is stored and explicitly moved; static assertions preserve its actual noexcept move properties.

Move construction and assignment move the actual core value while retaining source shell and moved-from core object. Actual Detector::match reinitializes null core impl on reuse; no-reuse uses actual local state. Reset replaces actual workspace outside call clocks.

All seven V11 option bits map correctly, flags above 127 reject, log_timing is explicit. API clock starts immediately before actual match and ends after returned raw vector is materialized. Neutral conversion and returned-vector destruction occur after end stamp.
Legacy and explicit-default overloads exactly match frozen API signatures; legacy TLS workspace belongs to each private core. Both use identical external clock boundaries and record conversion.
Copies signed32 x/y/template ID, complete class string and binary32 score through memcpy; timing fields match actual MatchTimings field order. No candidate field or order is filtered.

HMOUT001, call ID/count and per-record signed coordinates/template ID modulo uint32, raw score bits and uint64 class byte length are little-endian. Class byte insertion preserves embedded NUL and high bytes, output order and duplicate multiplicity.

Prepared literal fixtures cover signed fields, signed-zero bits, embedded NUL, empty output, duplicate multiplicity, order and call identity. Independent standard-library literal arithmetic confirms 51-byte single and 78-byte duplicate encodings; native encoder test remains unexecuted.

Existing core stamps search immediately after consolidation and total after no-reuse cleanup; candidate old-input destruction remains inside its helper, before either stamp. Wrapper returned-U-vector destruction is outside external clock by design.

remaining_validation.required: Generate and freeze exact baseline bytes and candidate two-seam transform, including all copied headers/helper bytes, before compiling either TU.
Independently prove candidate only adds one helper include and replaces the unique consolidation call; verify source/dependency closures and symbol isolation after actual build.
Native lifetime matrix must exercise real core workspace move construction, move assignment, moved-from reuse, reset, size/detector switches and independent concurrent workspaces.
Actual full-API correctness matrix and complete output archives must verify all option combinations, masks, default/legacy and class-filter routes before timing.
Compile/run the literal output contract, then independently decode every retained archive and reject field/order/score-bit/count corruption.

No timing result exists yet; measure the declared balanced full-call schedule only after frozen build, replay and correctness gates pass. No speed/accuracy/memory or production adoption claim follows from static review.

limitations: Generated core snapshots and a full harness are not available in this static slice, so no compile/link or actual behavioral result is asserted.
Private namespace and Timer isolation are source-level only until actual dependency and symbol evidence is available.
The separate standalone allocation-fault limitation remains: 26 observed executable-global-new faults do not independently demonstrate dynamic-runtime string-copy allocation failure.
